corrected.one_liner: Cloud CRM and application platform covering sales, service, marketing and custom apps, with a metadata-driven data model exposed through APIs.
corrected.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 through an External Client App (newer) or Connected App (legacy). The JWT bearer flow is confirmed via Salesforce docs search results (needs a pre-approved integration user and an uploaded certificate). Authorization code with PKCE, client credentials and refresh token are not confirmed by a fetched page. A SOAP login() session ID is also reportedly accepted as a bearer (unverified). MCP auth is External Client Apps only, with scopes mcp_api and refresh_token (confirmed from the hosted MCP FAQ).
corrected.access_notes: A free Developer Edition org (developer.salesforce.com/signup) reportedly includes API access, but the signup page returned 403 and this is unverified. Production API access depends on edition (Enterprise, Unlimited and Performance include it; other editions may need an add-on), also unverified. Hosted MCP servers are GA per the Salesforce GitHub README and FAQ, are disabled by default and are enabled by an admin in Setup > API Catalog > MCP Servers. Edition requirements and billing for MCP are not stated on fetched pages.
corrected.blocker: Each customer org must create and approve an External Client App (OAuth), and an admin must enable the API and any MCP servers. Production API access depends on edition, and per-org API call limits apply. Vendor developer docs returned 403, so access, edition and API-type claims are unverified.
